name: Phonetics
description: A collection of all the Phonetic objects in the specified range.
remarks: Each Phonetic object contains information about a specific phonetic text string.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: Start
properties.description: Returns the position that represents the first character of a phonetic text string in the specified cell. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Length
properties.description: Returns a Long value that represents the number of characters of phonetic text from the position you've specified with the Start property.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that determines whether the object is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: CharacterType
properties.description: Returns or sets the type of phonetic text in the specified cell. Read/write XlPhoneticCharacterType.

properties.name: Alignment
properties.description: Returns or sets a Long value that represents the alignment for the specified phonetic text or tick label.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns a Font object that represents the font of the specified object.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a single object from a collection.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Returns or sets the text for the specified object. Read/write String.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Start As Long, Length As Long, Text As String)
methods.description: Adds phonetic text to the specified cell.

parameters.name: Start
parameters.description: The position that represents the first character in the specified cell.

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: The number of characters from the _Start_ position to the end of the text in the cell.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: Collectively, the characters that represent the phonetic text in the cell.
